title: DPD-1.3 — Verification And Contract Transfer Evidence
summary: record the final immediate-Delete verification matrix, durable contract transfer, generated checks, and parked DPD-1 closeout
content_html:
DPD-1.3 — Verification And Contract Transfer Evidence

Result

DPD-1 is complete and parked. Confirmed parent and child document Delete immediately remove any exact current public projection and affected inventories after canonical and working commit. Scope-wide Publish retains positive promotion and removes only current explicit publishability exclusions. DPD-1.3 adds focused test evidence and durable documentation only; it changes no production behavior and does not start SSP-8.

Verification Matrix

case evidence
Published direct parent without lineage Exact by-ID and owned Mermaid removal; tree, Recent, search, locations, and Work URL filtering; sibling and out-of-workflow bytes retained.
Checked parent with descendant Parent preview expands the source hierarchy once and passes the exact two-document set into public cleanup. Existing union tests cover checked bulk roots without duplicate descendants.
Published child Exact child by-ID and manifest removal; host, sibling, parent tree/Recent/search bytes retained; derived location and Series URL removed. The maintained child Delete route smoke passes.
Published report host Host projection and host-derived parent/child routes disappear while child manifest, by-ID, Mermaid, source, and configuration remain independently owned.
Local and already-unprojected documents Local cleanup is not applicable. Repeated cleanup of an already-absent exact public projection is unchanged with no paths, URLs, or Catalogue targets.
Next Publish After immediate cleanup and a current working projection, Publish reports zero changed, zero excluded, and up_to_date: true; the unrelated missing-source public file remains present.
Explicit Publish exclusions Publish emits only excluded/excluded_count, removes false parent, descendants, child entries, and their exact owned products, retains unrelated or missing-source files, and has no retired removal alias.
Lifecycle and failure boundaries Public scope/sub-scope lifecycle applies required Catalogue follow-through. Public/Catalogue failure after source commit returns committed non-success and is not presented as retry-safe.

Executable Evidence

  • With an isolated writable DOTLINEFORM_PROJECTS_BASE_DIR, the focused Delete, Publish, mutation, child Delete, lifecycle, route, publishability, location, Catalogue, public-runtime, and capability suite passed: 140 passed.
  • admin-app/commands/run_checks.py --profile docs-viewer-smoke --run-id dpd-1-3-closeout passed all 28 checks, including source lint, site validation, the sub-scope Delete route, Manage service, and public read-only browser boundary. Summary: var/admin/test-runs/dpd-1-3-closeout/summary.md.
  • bin/lint-python docs-viewer/tests/python/test_docs_public_delete_cleanup.py passed.
  • bin/lint-js across the three DPD-1.2 management modules passed.
  • Python compilation across the changed cleanup and browser smoke tests passed.
  • bin/lint --scope studio and admin-app/checks/audit_projection_contract.py passed.
  • Explicit Studio Docs and search writes were no-ops after live projection: 283 documents, zero document/index writes or removals, zero warnings, and zero search writes.
  • Generated assertions confirmed exact done delivery/evidence payloads plus one evidence tree placement, one Recent entry, and one search entry. git diff --check passed.

Durable Contract Transfer

  • Management Operations owns exact parent/child targeting, apply order, strict committed-failure reporting, browser refresh ownership, and the Publish exclusion boundary.
  • Source Mutation Endpoints owns public_cleanup preview/apply response meaning and the exact child revision request.
  • Docs Viewer Projection Map and Projection Contract distinguish positive Publish from exact negative Delete without copying pending working bytes.
  • Public Scopes owns the public data flow, immediate inventory consequences, local no-op, and next-Publish result.
  • Publishable field owns false-only exclusion and missing-source retention semantics.
  • Scope Lifecycle owns whole-scope Catalogue refresh and recorded report-host follow-through without converting collection deletion into inferred document deletes.

Closeout Review

The final DPD-1.3 production footprint is zero. Its code change is three focused service cases for descendant expansion, already-unprojected no-op, and next-Publish idempotence. The remaining change is concise durable transfer and this evidence. Review found no scope-wide Publish call from Delete, working-to-public copy during cleanup, publication or lineage inference, shared-media deletion, route-shaped child cascade, compatibility alias, new control, new retry/rollback framework, SSP-8 implementation, or delivery-material retirement.

DPD-1 is parked at its completed closeout review gate.
